items.title: fix(sessions): deleted sessions remain visible during worker cleanup …
items.summary: fix(sessions): deleted sessions remain visible during worker cleanup (#132233) * fix(sessions): delete immediately and safely reclaim workers Remove confirmed selections optimistically, retain canonical generation ownership across stale responses and reconnects, and reconcile failures without restoring old navigation. Share archive/delete lifecycle drains and safely reclaim worker workspaces before deletion commits. Preserve exact caller, session, and placement authority through asynchronous cleanup. Fixes #132057. * test(sessions): align fixtures with canonical deletion ownership Use real session capability publications, support independent subscribers, assert postcommit placement retirement, and distinguish selected threads from the configured main session in browser fixtures. Preserve archived-action and geometry assertions. * fix(sessions): bind delete events to the removed generation Carry deleted session identity from lifecycle results, skip current-row enrichment for deletion broadcasts, and reconcile key-only notifications without purging a replacement. Cover delayed events, incognito reset, and the real RPC-to-broadcast boundary. Record the final measured startup baseline within the approved adjustment.
